normalization_plan.reason: amount is a transient ERC20 parameter fully absorbed by the transfer entry point
recipient is only used to direct the transfer destination
sender is only used as the source of the transferFrom flow
tAmount is the input consumed entirely by the reflection accounting routine
from is a transient argument of the internal transfer routine
to is a transient argument of the internal transfer routine
tokenAmount only parameterizes the router swap
maxTxAmount is only used to conditionally update the cap state
sellTax is only used to conditionally update the sell tax state
buyTax is only used to conditionally update the buy tax state
bots_ exists solely to populate the blacklist mapping
notbot exists solely to clear one blacklist entry
rFee is a short-lived intermediate that immediately feeds the reflection burn arithmetic
tFee is a short-lived intermediate that immediately feeds the fee total accumulation
tTeam is a short-lived intermediate consumed by the team credit routine
currentRate is a short-lived intermediate used only to scale the team credit
contractTokenBalance is measured only to be swapped away
contractETHBalance is measured only to be forwarded to the fee address
